name: security-testing-hub
description: Open-source SAST scanner for Node.js/Express apps — catches SQL injection, XSS, command injection, path traversal and CSRF in vibe-coded JS/TS projects.

scripts.build: npm run build -w security-hub-scanner && npm run build -w security-hub
scripts.test: npm run test -w security-hub-scanner && npm run test -w security-hub
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npx --workspace=security-hub-scanner jest --coverage --coverageReporters=text-summary && npx --workspace=security-hub jest --coverage --coverageReporters=text-summary

author: Damir Panzhazov
